content_evals.prompt: Prepare the digest-bound ChatGPT Pro primary from the active feature's pushed branch and semantic bundle.
expected_behaviors: runs the deterministic context manifest with live remote verification
names the exact repository, branch, commit, and required relative paths
keeps clean committed sources on GitHub rather than uploading duplicates
prepares one exact prompt whose completed response can be captured only through its receipt-bound lifecycle
anti_behaviors: silently queries the default branch
claims that literal plugin connector text invokes GitHub
pushes a branch itself or uploads standalone files without an action-time checkpoint

content_evals.prompt: The spec-feature root pushed its decision-complete checkpoint. Run the digest-bound Pro primary under standing authority.
expected_behaviors: requires spec_workflow and digest_bound_standing plus complete generic work and source bindings
claims one receipt-bound primary send intent without creating a bearer, capability reference, lease digest, or sidecar
submits exactly once in a verified Pro conversation

binds the exact same-send conversation and opaque generation under the unreconciled receipt revision before registering any wait, while stating that the Browser exposes no attested receipt the bridge can authenticate
registers a same-task heartbeat and consumes fresh task-local typed wait results for the current consultation, attempt, generation, and task
yields only after heartbeat_registered and captures only after generation_completed

captures the full response Markdown with a same-task typed result binding its digest to the canonical current conversation, committed binding digest, observed generation ID, and unreconciled receipt revision, rejecting a different capture generation or payload without claiming Browser attestation
publishes one immutable consumed continuation pass and returns record_pro_primary to the parent
anti_behaviors: opens Finder, Chrome, or Computer Use
polls the Browser from the root while generation is running
presses Answer now, Stop answering, or an equivalent early-stop control without exact user authorization for the current conversation
claims receipt revision CAS is a coordinator-only or model-inaccessible capability boundary
stores a conversation URL without the live capture CAS
falls back to another primary planner

content_evals.prompt: The Pro prompt was sent, but the current task cannot register its heartbeat. Resume safely when the operator returns.
expected_behaviors: consumes a typed manual_resume_required capability-probe result and claims neither yield nor future wake
reports manual_resume_required without Browser polling or capture
requires manual_resume_observed from the same task and current attempt and generation
requires a subsequent current manual generation_completed result before one inspection and capture
anti_behaviors: treats a later root turn as completed-generation evidence
manufactures a heartbeat receipt
captures directly from manual_resume_required
reopens a reconciled send intent

content_evals.prompt: The admitted Pro heartbeat woke this same task, but Browser cleanup removed the bound tab and the Browser now lists zero tabs. Continue the exact planning generation.
expected_behaviors: keeps the persistent in-app Browser binding and discards only the missing tab binding
reopens the exact receipt-bound canonical conversation URL
verifies the committed conversation and generation before continuing the same generation
treats exact-conversation reopening as producer reacquisition rather than conversation substitution
continues automatically without manual recovery
anti_behaviors: reports manual_resume_required solely because the tab handle disappeared
records BLK-PRO-UNCERTAIN-SEND or reconcile-wake solely for tab cleanup
resends the planning prompt or opens a different conversation
asks the user to reopen the planning tab

content_evals.prompt: The current Pro heartbeat reports generation_completed. Reconcile the canonical continuation and keep the active spec-work job moving.
expected_behaviors: treats generation completion as the end of waiting rather than whole-workflow completion
reloads canonical state and the continuation cursor in the same root trajectory
captures and classifies current unconsumed evidence, then executes the returned parent_action
runs claim_successor_send for a prepared attempt 2 or record_pro_primary for a valid response before the final heartbeat envelope
yields when a prepared successor records a fresh heartbeat_registered result
executes a pending canonical parent_action or continuation cursor after stale or duplicate terminal evidence
continues until a genuine user, blocker, manual-resume, or workflow-terminal boundary
anti_behaviors: returns a quiet terminal response merely because the wait generation completed
claims the workflow is complete while canonical state remains nonterminal
requires another user message to begin an already prepared successor

content_evals.prompt: The captured attempt-1 Pro response contains useful repository-grounded planning with an introductory paragraph, tables, and noncanonical heading organization. Recover proportionally; also explain what happens when the root determines a response has no substantive planning analysis, and when its derived attempt-2 successor is claimed but reconciled before any submission is committed.
expected_behaviors: classifies useful planning content as valid regardless of presentation and returns parent_action record_pro_primary
preserves the immutable original response and unchanged consumed continuation pass
records ordinary clean evidence from the original artifact and digest without a derived view, correction receipt, or normalization annotation
creates no successor, send intent, Browser send, resend, or stage restart for valid
uses --semantically-unusable only after a root-owned content decision and reserves one derived attempt-2 consultation for restart_or_fail_closed
claims, waits for, and captures an authorized attempt 2 through the ordinary public commands
after explicit BLK-PRO-UNCERTAIN-SEND clearance, replaces only the same-locator reconciled unbound successor as attempt 2 while preserving attempt-1 evidence
returns BLK-PRO-INVALID-RESPONSE-EXHAUSTED without a third attempt when attempt 2 is invalid
anti_behaviors: overwrites or deletes attempt-1 evidence
reuses the reconciled attempt-1 send intent
invalidates a presentation variant or advances its continuation
accepts a caller-selected successor locator or substituted conversation
replaces a live, bound, committed, captured, or uncleared attempt-2 successor
creates an unbounded attempt array

content_evals.prompt: Admit a useful completed Pro response with a preamble, extra headings, and a table, then continue planning even though it also contains a GitHub-access statement.
expected_behaviors: treats requested headings as readability guidance rather than an admission protocol
accepts preambles, epilogues, extra or mixed-depth headings, tables, and equivalent organization when the root judges the content useful
preserves the immutable response while allowing the root to synthesize its content into canonical planning artifacts
validates the original immutable response, digest, manifest, repository, branch, and source-commit identity before disposition
treats source-access prose as planning input rather than automatic retry authority
verifies material cited paths and repository claims against the exact checkout and source commit before plan adoption
excludes or explicitly annotates unsupported claims and uses semantic_response_unusable only when the verified remainder cannot support planning
anti_behaviors: uses Markdown presentation to reserve a retry or create presentation-correction state
matches natural-language source-access phrases to invalidate the response or reserve attempt 2
adopts a material repository claim without exact-checkout verification
changes the immutable producer response while reconciling unsupported claims
treats provenance bookkeeping alone as semantic_response_unusable

content_evals.prompt: The captured Pro primary was invalidated because it could not retrieve the required source files. The exact local source inventory, specification digest, source commit, and planning scope are verified. Continue without another Pro send.
expected_behaviors: preserves the immutable invalidated primary and exact revision-2 continuation
does not claim or send the reserved successor
has the coordinator synthesize the exact locally verified Plan
requires a fresh CLEAN blind-completeness receipt
uses source_access_recovery so adopt-plan records the canonical coordinator exception without renewed user authorization
anti_behaviors: resends the primary or claims the reserved successor
requires a new user authorization for source_access_recovery
uses captureless_pro_recovery for the invalidated-primary trajectory
manufactures active response evidence or bypasses the blind audit

content_evals.prompt: The typed applicability receipt is otherwise exact, but toSourceCommit is stale. A fresh source observation says local HEAD and the live verified remote branch head are one commit. Continue proportionally.
expected_behaviors: strictly validates every original receipt field and considers reconciliation only when changing toSourceCommit alone produces a valid receipt

requires active immutable evidence, checked-out HEAD, one live verified remote branch head, current approved source bytes, recomputed changed paths, evidence anchors, and a monotonic assessment epoch to prove one candidate
preserves the original typed receipt and every semantic field while publishing a distinct canonical effective receipt plus spec-work-artifact-correction lineage
treats equal immutable publication as idempotent and conflicting or unbound artifacts as non-authoritative
avoids one fresh Pro primary and one blind audit without sending, resending, replacing a task, or restarting a stage
anti_behaviors: reconciles another applicability field or chooses among multiple candidates
trusts a remote-tracking ref or a manifest that is not live verified
rewrites the original receipt
starts another Pro consultation or blind audit

content_evals.prompt: The digest-bound Pro prompt was submitted once, but exact response identity is unavailable before capture. Reconcile safely without sending again.
expected_behaviors: uses the stateless normalize-conversation-url oracle only to distinguish canonical ChatGPT URL syntax from malformed or spoofed input
treats unavailable exact response identity as fail-closed even though the receipt retains the send intent
uses wake-free reconciliation with the exact receipt, bundle state, and continuation
atomically reconciles the active send revision once and returns BLK-PRO-UNCERTAIN-SEND
returns Browser, send, resend, navigation, automation, and conversation-substitution authority false
repeated wake-free reconciliation is byte-stable and does not advance revision
anti_behaviors: persists or consumes a normalized URL as lifecycle or planning evidence
fabricates response identity from consultation, prompt digest, or attempted time
uses a fixed delay or searches for a replacement conversation
resubmits the prompt or binds any transient or canonical candidate
